title: What If You Swallow Magnetic Balls?
sources: American Academy of Pediatrics, Ingested Neodymium Magnets
Mayo Clinic, Multiple magnet ingestion and bowel perforation
Consumer Product Safety Commission, High-powered magnetic balls

lines.text: What happens if you accidentally swallow two rare earth magnetic balls?
lines.caps: What *happens | if you swallow | *two magnetic balls?

lines.text: If you swallow just one, it usually passes harmlessly through your body.
But with two or more, a catastrophic disaster begins.
lines.caps: With *two or more | a *catastrophic disaster | begins

lines.text: As they move through your digestive tract at different speeds, they enter separate loops of your intestines.
Their powerful neodymium magnetic force snaps them together through your intestinal walls.
This clamps your organs shut, completely cutting off blood supply.
Within hours, the pinched tissue dies, boring holes through your digestive tract and causing septic shock.
This requires immediate emergency surgery to save your life.
Never play with magnetic balls near your mouth.
